d:
Bihar Weather Alert : bihar men mausam badalne ki sanbhavna hai. patna samet 13 jilon men barish, garaj-chamak aur vajrapat ko lekar alart ki jankari samne aaee hai. 29 aur 30 aktubar ko rajy ke kaee hisson men barish ki sanbhavna jataee gaee hai. janie kin jilon men mausam ka asar dikh sakta hai aur logon ko kin savdhaniyon ka dhyan rakhna chahie.
Mausam se jure taja apdet ke lie jure rahen.
